event: US October core PCE on Wed 25 Nov (FXStreet; time UNVERIFIED, usually 15:30 SAST). Thu 26 Nov: US Thanksgiving, thin trade. Fed decision 9 Dec.

bullets.title: Slipped back
bullets.text: FXStreet put gold near 3,635 in early Asian trade on Tuesday, back inside the 3,630-3,650 zone after Monday's push above 3,650 (exact live price UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Sitting on pivot
bullets.text: Today's daily pivot is about 3,628, so price is right at the line between buyers and sellers.

bullets.title: Hike bets trimmed
bullets.text: FXStreet says markets no longer price a 50 bp December hike, but a 25 bp hike is still expected, which keeps pressure on gold.

bullets.title: Momentum weak
bullets.text: The 14-day RSI is around 33 and price is under the 100-day average near 4,175, so the bigger trend is still down.

bullets.title: Dollar and yields
bullets.text: Monday's reports had the dollar index near 104.5 and the 10-year near 4.94%; no fresh reading was found today (UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: PCE on Wednesday
bullets.text: Core PCE inflation on Wednesday can move gold fast either way, and Thanksgiving on Thursday will thin trading.
